node.title: Re: Problems with number resolution
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[davies] has already linked you to [http://floating-point-gui.de|What Every Programmer Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic], which is definitely worth reading, and [poj] has shown you one possible solution. Here are two more that give the desired output:

If you don't care about the inaccurate internal representation, use [doc://printf] for output, as in: printf "%.2f => %.2f\n", $_, $x;

If you don't care so much about the performance of your program, stick a [doc://bignum|use bignum;] at the top of your program (or at least in the lexical scope of the code you showed).
